items.reply: I retain TP: identical uppercase anchors in English and translation bypass santizeAnchors(), then are removed by the sanitizer because neither policy allows anchors. The resulting mismatch causes ThemeVerifierMojo to fail the build, so this affects behavior rather than style. The placeholder exceptions are key-specific preprocessing and do not establish an intentional lowercase-only HTML contract. Absence of uppercase tags in current bundles makes this an uncommon-input defect, not a nit.
